channel.title: The Mutapa Times — Daily Zimbabwe Weather + Tsumo
channel.description: Daily weather forecast for Zimbabwe's main cities plus the Tsumo yezuva (proverb of the day). One item per day, dedicated for the Mutapa Times weather autolist.

item.title: Zim weather 13 Aug: Harare overcast · high 19° / low 10°
item.description: Harare: high 19°, low 10° (overcast) · Bulawayo: high 14°, low 9° (light drizzle) · Mutare: high 16°, low 11° (heavy drizzle) · Gweru: high 14°, low 8° (light drizzle) · Masvingo: high 13°, low 10° (light drizzle) · Victoria Falls: high 25°, low 15° (overcast) Tsumo yezuva: Zingizi gonyera pamwe maruva enyika haaperi.
